text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, it's pretty rare for you to tag 
along for extra practice.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, kinda-sorta. My mood? Like, feeling 
like I can totally do it right now?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What's that about... Well, whatever. Let's 
go!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was a great run! The wind felt 
sooo good~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm... When you stare at me like that, 
it kinda makes me nervous, y'know...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you noticed? You just ran all that 
way, yet you look completely unfazed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whoa, you're right! I'm not tired 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? What is this, a miracle!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that just shows what great training 
they're doing, right? Together with that 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... well, I guess so. He feels kinda 
loud and overly passionate, but... somehow 
his teaching is really easy to understand.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...K-Keep this a secret from her, okay? 
She'd totally get cocky and annoying about 
it."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm thirsty! Gimme a sec, I'll go buy 
some drinks!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...She's still got the stamina to run?
